building: Morgan J. Burke Boilermaker Aquatic Center
scope: Only the Aquatic Center asset and its dedicated audit directory were changed. No master/shared/index/README/manifest edits and no commit.
reviewer_r5_findings: Make a visible improvement in building form or spatial presentation.
Hall still reads repetitive beneath a broad shallow roof; no measured support exists for roof shape or height.
Seating/rails remain schematic and sign is small from a distance.
Strengthen interior context and seating read while separating approximate site dressing from georeferenced placement.

sources.name: Purdue Athletics official facility photo gallery
sources.supports: Building-specific interior photographs show a high-volume natatorium, exposed light steel roof structure, overhead lighting, spectator seating, and Purdue displays; photos are qualitative and not measured.

sources.name: Arsee Engineers athletics projects
sources.supports: Engineer project photo shows Purdue Aquatic Center interior with exposed white steel trusses and pool/gallery context; no dimensions or member schedule.

sources.name: Purdue RecWell Aquatics
sources.supports: Published aquatic program, pool details and 625 spectator capacity.

sources.name: Tnemec Boilermaker Aquatic Center profile
sources.supports: Protected steel roof deck and coating finish context; does not support roof shape or dimensions.

sources.name: Official GIS footprint, FID 896
sources.supports: Horizontal building outline only; not survey control or master placement.

changes: Changed the existing 21 schematic clear-span truss meshes to a warm white painted-steel material supported qualitatively by facility photos; geometry, spacing, sections and elevations remain schematic.

Added 15 small high-bay fixture blocks and two hanging black-and-gold Purdue display panels, based on facility-photo motifs. Their exact position, dimensions, number and lighting plan are visual estimates.

Added a longitudinal interior camera and a closer seating/gallery presentation camera. The cutaway render hides the roof and optional site context, and uses a neutral background; render visibility flags are restored after each render.
Retained the optional site dressing in its separate approximate, un-georeferenced collection.
uncertainties: No measured roof section, roof profile, or eave/ridge heights were found.
The truss material character is photo-supported, but truss geometry, layout and dimensions are schematic.
High-bay lights and hanging-banner location/size/count are qualitative estimates, not measured/as-built data.
The 288 modeled seats are representative; published capacity is 625. Exact stand and circulation layout remain uncertain.
Optional site dressing is approximate and not georeferenced.
GIS-to-shell correspondence does not prove survey accuracy or master-scene placement.
